fields.FIR_Description: During the afternoon of 2025-09-18, around 14:45, the complainant was allegedly surrounded and attacked by several persons near Vetri Colony Industrial Area in Erode after a dispute over a traffic incident, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-09-18. Selvam Natarajan approached Erode North PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000001. Another person, Saravanan Anand, using the number 9000000282, was named as potentially involved. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Jagan Raman, using the number 9000000369. The complainant noted the registration number TN-33-ZZ-1029 of a yellow van. Potentially relevant material referenced includes CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Group allegedly confronted the victim following an earlier dispute. A van was reportedly used to leave the area.
fields.Keywords: group assault, injury, industrial area, suspect, CCTV, mobile number, van, afternoon
